# Atomic Flux

> Atomic Flux is a dead-simple, private habit tracker for iOS. It turns tiny daily wins
> into streaks, with an optional home-screen widget, self-reported progress, and a habit
> library covering health, focus, and companion-app-linked habits. Most data stays on
> the device by default; an optional Apple or Google sign-in adds cross-device backup.

## Pages

- [Home](https://atomicflux.app/): product overview, feature walkthrough, and how habit
  tracking works in the app.
- [Privacy Policy](https://atomicflux.app/privacy/): exactly what data Atomic Flux
  collects, when, and why — including what's collected before and after signing in.
- [Support](https://atomicflux.app/support/): contact and FAQ for app support requests.
